questions.question:
The bar graph given below shows the expenditure of two companies L and M in different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6132cdece3a86c299d3fb5df80270cb6ce1490fbb4d46f69a013bbc0d5041663.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The expenditure of company L in Y2 is 33.33 percent of the expenditure of M in year Y3.

II. The expenditure of company M in year Y5 is 100 percent of the expenditure of L in year Y4.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

**Statement I:**

The expenditure of company L in Y2 = 400

The expenditure of company M in Y3 = 600

Percentage of the expenditure of company L in Y2 to the expenditure of M in year Y3 = 400/600 × 100 = 66.66%

Statement I is wrong.

**Statement II:**

The expenditure of company M in year Y5 = 300

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b26d1f5de38a619055bf53ff26418da0bba0ec24f8f65f93717df8fbaa14acb.png] 

What is the ratio of average number of females in all the five organizations to the average number of males in all the five organizations?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of males in all the five organizations = (250 + 225 + 325 + 275 + 150)

⇒ 1225

Average number of males in all the five organizations = 1225/5 = 245

Total number of females in all the five organizations = (300 + 275 + 250 + 200 + 125)

⇒ 1150

Required ratio = 230 : 245

⇒ 46 : 49

**∴ The ratio of average number of females in all the five organizations to the average number of males in all the five organizations is 46 : 49**

questions.question:
Study the following graph and answer the given question.

The graph shows the time (in minutes) taken by the pipes (A, B), (C, D), (E, F), (G, H), and (P, Q) to fill a tank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9bff83ed10a59ff4090a9cb9ba04555ae53a010908bc03016fca61ee32830d2.png] 

Two pipes P and Q are inlet pipes. If they are opened at alternate minutes and if pipe P is opened first, then in how many minutes will the tank be full?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Time taken by P to fill the tank = 15 minutes

P's 1 minute work = 1/15 

Time taken by Q to fill the tank = 30 minutes

Q's 1 minute work = 1/30

Now, they are opened at alternate minutes

In 2 minutes = 1/15 + 1/30 = 3/30 = 1/10 tank is filled 

**Time taken to completely fill the tank = 2 × 10 = 20 minutes **

questions.question:
The given bar graph shows the number of students enrolled in Institutes A and B during 5 years (2018 to 2022).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f80adbf25cc0acef39328a76731b320265ef51741072deb92b48eb0bbc2faf7.png] 

What is the ratio of the total students enrolled in Institute B in 2019, 2020 and 2022 to that of the total students enrolled in Institute A in 2018, 2020 and 2021?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Students enrolled in Institute B in 2019 = 350

Students enrolled in Institute B in 2020 = 375

Students enrolled in Institute B in 2022 = 200

Total students enrolled in Institute A in 2018 = 150

Total students enrolled in Institute A in 2020 = 300

Total students enrolled in Institute A in 2021 = 250

**Formula used:**

Ratio = dfrac{{Total students in Institute B (2019, 2020, 2022)}}{{Total students in Institute A (2018, 2020, 2021)}}

**Calculations:**

Total students in Institute B (2019, 2020, 2022) = 350 + 375 + 200 = 925

Total students in Institute A (2018, 2020, 2021) = 150 + 300 + 250 = 700

⇒ Ratio = dfrac{925}{700}

⇒ Ratio = dfrac{37}{28}

**∴ The correct answer is 37 : 28.**

Difference between 2014 and 2015 as production rise = 50 – 20 = 30 lakh tonnes.

**∴ The percentage production rise/fall from the previous year for country R is maximum in 2015**
